_comment: Pre-registered wave membership and concurrency (DESIGN.md section 3). launch_wave.sh accepts only a wave name from this file. The canary is the first L1 run launched alone to validate the harness; wave1 is the remaining light runs launched together; wave2 runs the CPU-heavy L3 sessions two at a time in the stated order.
_wave2_relaunch: 2026-09-05 (DESIGN.md section 9): wave2 produced no result on 2026-09-03 (credit refusals; opus5 L3 r1 cut off by print mode's background-task wait ceiling). The void fable51 L3 directories are archived under _void_wave2_credit_refusal/. Pair A of the relaunch is the single permitted resume of opus5_L3_r1 (scripts/resume_run.sh) beside wave2_pairA_fable; pair B is wave2_pairB. Same order and the same two-at-a-time rule as wave2.
_extension_a: Pre-registered 2026-09-05 (DESIGN.md section 11): the OpenAI models gpt-6-astra (tag astra), gpt-5.6-sol (sol) and gpt-5.5 (gpt55) on the same harness through the local gateway, three runs per level each. ext_canary validates the route alone; ext_waveA is every remaining L1 and L2 run; ext_waveB is the nine L3 runs two at a time, interleaved by model so no model gets all the late-night slots.

usage_gate.note: A wave launches only if the latest rate_limit_event across all session logs shows five-hour utilization at or below this value, or its resetsAt is in the past (fresh window).
